findings.text: follow-on: pre-existing flake outside this node's write scope, surfaced by the reviewed run's own gate. test_dispatch_marks_old_published_window_stale derives candidate['budget_age_s'] from wall clock rather than the captured moment, so under -n 6 load the age drifts past the approx(7200, abs=1) bound: gate-head.log shows 7203.582902 == 7200 +/- 1, turning the head arm red while the serial rerun (gate-head-2.log) passes. The test should freeze its clock or widen the bound to the load it runs under; it is not this node's file to change.

follow-on (observation, not a defect): the stamp helper swap narrows the cache stamp from ledger._file_identity's (mtime_ns, ctime_ns, size, ino) to capabilities.file_stamp's [mtime_ns, size]. Every content edit still moves mtime_ns and a rename still reads None, so the rename case is caught, but a metadata-only change (chmod) no longer invalidates the cached resolution. The plan directs this change, so it is intended; flagging in case the weaker stamp matters elsewhere.

item_verdicts.call_sites: one production call site: the stamp_of closure inside _resolved_plan_path in reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py, reached from the capability stage's plan resolution. On base the same name was ledger._file_identity.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit-by-commit against base 8d70f1091: the only functional change is stamp_of calling capabilities.file_stamp(path) instead of ledger._file_identity(Path(path)), replacing a 4-tuple stamp (mtime,ctime,size,ino) with file_stamp's [mtime_ns,size]; the 2-tuple still moves on in-place edit and reads None when the file is gone, which is the rename case. The new test warms the pick, renames probe.html to relocated-probe.html, and asserts the section effort 10.0 is re-resolved rather than the plan default 48.0.
item_verdicts.done_when: the section's done-when is that the renamed-plan case fails when the cache serves the old resolution and stamp_of calls no private ledger name. I reproduced the red independently: a pytest plugin that makes capabilities.cached_pick_input_stamped match on request key only reddens the new test 48.0==10.0 EXIT=1, and the head arm passes (1 passed, EXIT=0). grep confirms reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py no longer references ledger in any stamp path. The reviewed run's after arm is 171 passed (gate-head-2.log), base 170 passed (gate-base.log), 0 added failures.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the pick's plan-resolution cache is proved against a renamed plan and stamp_of stops naming the ledger's private helper; the diff replaces ledger._file_identity with capabilities.file_stamp inside _resolved_plan_path's stamp_of (reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:121) and narrows the lazy import to `from reckon import capabilities`, and adds test_a_renamed_plan_file_is_not_served_stale to tests/test_pick_stages_fit_the_bound.py. Both halves of section 24 are present.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commit debeb5bb7, base 8d70f1091, after_suite 171 passed (gate-head-2.log), baseline_suite 170 passed (gate-base.log), negative_control EXIT=1, and measurement_module/cwd under the run scratch. Its fields reconcile with the four logs on disk, whose first lines name revision, tree and command.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff debeb5bb7 touches three paths: reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py and tests/test_pick_stages_fit_the_bound.py (section 24's declared write paths) plus a stub docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/pick-cache-proved-on-a-renamed-plan.html, all four declared in the run's orientation_write_paths. No out-of-grant path is touched.

justifications.durability: the negative control reddens and the test is fixture-driven, date-free, and isolated (RECKON_HOME and RECKON_PICK_CACHE point at the test tmp tree), so it is a real regression guard for the stamp; nothing guards the removal of the private name beyond reading.
justifications.evidence: the head arm reproduces (1 passed EXIT=0) and the negative control reproduces independently (ignore-stamp plugin reddens 48.0==10.0, EXIT=1); both arms's gate logs carry a base 170 passed and a head 171 passed with 0 added failures. Weakness: the manifest's failure_attribution is empty while retry_failures records a head-arm-1 suite failure, and the new test passes on base as well as head, so it pins the cache's stamp behaviour but not the helper swap itself.
justifications.fit: the change uses capabilities.file_stamp, the helper the plan names and the module already imports, and narrows the lazy import to the one module still used — matching the picker's in-function import idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: both halves of section 24 are implemented exactly as written: the renamed-plan case exists and the private ledger name is gone from stamp_of, replaced with the capabilities.file_stamp the module already imported.
justifications.reuse: the test reuses the existing repo fixture, PLAN_HTML and _run_pick rather than re-deriving them, and the fix reuses an existing public helper instead of reimplementing the stamp.
justifications.scope_discipline: only the two declared code paths plus a stub evidence fragment (all declared in orientation_write_paths) are touched; no unrelated file is changed and nothing is retired.
